resolved_gap.before: The public cart identified variants only by model/brand labels; two physical variants sharing those labels could be aggregated, mixing stock and choosing a minimum price, which was not a safe authority for an order/payment transition.
resolved_gap.after: The public catalog exposes ProductoVarianteId per active physical variant; checkout carries and returns that exact ID, recalculates stock and price from the exact active variant, and fails closed when a legacy label-only selection maps to more than one physical variant.

authority_reuse.stock: ExistenciaVariante remains the authoritative stock source surfaced by ProductoService; no parallel ecommerce stock store was created.
authority_reuse.orders: PedidosVentaController/PedidoVentaService remain the authenticated idempotent order mutation authority; no anonymous duplicate order endpoint was introduced.
authority_reuse.payments: PagosOnlineController/PagoOnline remain the authenticated tenant-scoped payment authority; no PAN/CVV or provider-secret surface was introduced.
authority_reuse.public_boundary: TiendaController remains an anonymous catalog and read/validation boundary. Its checkout endpoint recalculates server-authoritative price/stock but does not reserve stock or mutate ERP orders, preventing public bypass of ERP invariants.

security_decisions: Do not create an anonymous public order mutation without a durable customer identity, explicit physical allocation policy and end-to-end idempotency coordinate.
Do not expose internal PedidosVenta or PagosOnline mutation endpoints through the anonymous Tienda boundary.
Fail closed on ambiguous physical variants rather than aggregating their stock or selecting the lowest price.

cases: ProductoVarianteId selects one exact physical stock/price/SKU
legacy label-only ambiguous selection returns 409 conflict
public product contract exposes each physical variant with exact ProductoVarianteId

acceptance_mapping.public_api: PASS__exact variant identity and fail-closed validation
acceptance_mapping.stock_sync: PASS__server recomputes from current authoritative stock projection; no client stock accepted
acceptance_mapping.orders: PASS__existing protected idempotent PedidoVenta authority retained; no public bypass
acceptance_mapping.payments: PASS__existing protected PagoOnline authority retained; no sensitive card data surface
acceptance_mapping.problem_handling: PASS__invalid input -> 400; stale/missing/ambiguous product or variant -> 409 through existing ApiResponse contract
